currency_id.description: Currency ID for the credit note

is_draft.description: Set to true to save as draft

line_items.description: Line items for the credit note

item_id.description: Unique identifier for the item. Example: "260815000000100002"

line_item_id.description: Unique ID of an existing line item to update. Example: "260815000000111002"

tax_id.description: Tax ID applied to the line item

ignore_auto_number_generation.description: Set to true to provide a custom credit note number

actions.description: Update an estimate in Zoho Books.
actions.name: update-estimate

estimate_id.description: The estimate ID to update. Example: "260815000000101017"

organization_id.description: Zoho Books organization ID. If omitted and only one organization exists, it is used automatically. Required when multiple organizations exist.

customer_id.description: Customer ID for the estimate. Example: "260815000000097001"

actions.description: Update an expense in Zoho Books
actions.name: update-expense

expense_id.description: Unique identifier of the expense. Example: "260815000000106001"

organization_id.description: Zoho Books organization ID. If omitted and only one organization exists, it is used automatically. Required when multiple organizations exist.

account_id.description: ID of the expense account. Example: "260815000000000388"

date.description: Date of the expense. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

tax_id.description: Unique identifier of the tax. Example: "260815000000000097"

reference_number.description: Reference number of the expense. Max-length [100]

is_billable.description: To specify whether the expense is billable to the customer or not

currency_id.description: Unique identifier of the currency. Example: "260815000000000097"

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate of the currency with respect to the base currency

project_id.description: ID of the project associated with the customer

vendor_id.description: ID of the vendor the expense is made to. Example: "260815000000098001"

paid_through_account_id.description: ID of the paid through account

line_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the line item. Example: "260815000000106001"

account_id.description: ID of the expense account. Example: "260815000000000388"

description.description: Description of the expense line item. Max-length [100]

tax_id.description: Unique identifier of the tax. Example: "260815000000000097"

is_inclusive_tax.description: To specify whether the tax is inclusive in the amount or not

actions.description: Update an invoice in Zoho Books
actions.name: update-invoice

organization_id.description: Zoho Books organization ID. If omitted and only one organization exists, it is used automatically. Required when multiple organizations exist.

line_items.description: Line items to replace existing items

actions.description: Update an item in Zoho Books.
actions.name: update-item

item_id.description: Unique identifier of the item. Example: "260815000000100002"

organization_id.description: Zoho Books organization ID. If omitted and only one organization exists, it is used automatically. Required when multiple organizations exist.

tax_id.description: ID of the tax to be associated to the item.

sku.description: SKU value of item, should be unique throughout the product.

product_type.description: Type of an item. Allowed values: goods, service, digital_service.

item_type.description: Type of the item. Allowed values: sales, purchases, sales_and_purchases, inventory.

account_id.description: ID of the account to which the item has to be associated with.

purchase_account_id.description: ID of the COGS account to which the item has to be associated with.

inventory_account_id.description: ID of the stock account to which the item has to be associated with.

is_taxable.description: Boolean to track the taxability of the item.

purchase_tax_rule_id.description: Id of the purchase tax rule.

sales_tax_rule_id.description: Id of the sales tax rule.

purchase_tax_exemption_id.description: ID of the purchase tax exemption.

actions.description: Update a manual journal entry in Zoho Books.
actions.name: update-journal

organization_id.description: Zoho Books organization ID. If omitted and only one organization exists, it is used automatically. Required when multiple organizations exist.

journal_date.description: Date on which the journal is to be recorded. Example: "2026-06-09"

journal_type.description: Type of the journal. Allowed values: Cash, Both.

currency_id.description: ID of the currency associated with the journal.

account_id.description: ID of account for which journals are to be recorded.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer or vendor.

description.description: Description at the line item level.

amount.description: Amount to be recorded for the journal.

debit_or_credit.description: Whether the account needs to be debited or credited.

actions.description: Update a customer payment in Zoho Books.
actions.name: update-payment

organization_id.description: Zoho Books organization ID. If omitted and only one organization exists, it is used automatically. Required when multiple organizations exist.

account_id.description: ID of the cash/bank account the payment is deposited into.

retainerinvoice_id.description: ID of the retainer invoice associated with the payment.

actions.description: Update a purchase order in Zoho Books.
actions.name: update-purchase-order

purchaseorder_id.description: ID of the purchase order to update. Example: "260815000000062001"

organization_id.description: Zoho Books organization ID. If omitted and only one organization exists, it is used automatically. Required when multiple organizations exist.

line_item_id.description: Existing line item ID to update; omit to create a new line.

account_id.description: Account ID for the line item.

tax_id.description: Tax ID applicable to the line item.

item_order.description: Display order of the line item.

line_items.description: Line items for the purchase order.

is_discount_before_tax.description: Whether discount is applied before tax.

actions.description: Update a vendor payment in Zoho Books.

payment_id.description: ID of the vendor payment to update. Example: "260815000000116002"

organization_id.description: Zoho Books organization ID. If omitted and only one organization exists, it is used automatically. Required when multiple organizations exist.

vendor_id.description: ID of the vendor associated with the Vendor Payment

date.description: Date the payment is made. Format: yyyy-mm-dd

paid_through_account_id.description: ID of the cash/bank account from which the payment is made

description.description: Description for the Vendor Payment recorded

reference_number.description: Reference number for the Vendor Payment recorded

is_paid_via_print_check.description: Check if the Bill Payment is paid Via Print Check Option

bills.description: Individual bill payment details as array

bill_id.description: ID of the bill the payment is to be applied

tax_amount_withheld.description: Tax Amount Withheld during Bill Payment

custom_fields.description: Custom fields associated with the vendor payment
